purpose: Held-out validation set for v17.2 FLS grounding and live-topology resolution work.

entries.short_construct_description: unsafe extern blocks and unsafe attributes must remain visibly marked with `unsafe`
entries.reason_for_inclusion: Covers FFI / ABI / extern constructs without using a current validation-set draft and exercises non-glossary normative routing away from generic attribute matches.

entries.short_construct_description: functions should not recurse directly or indirectly
entries.reason_for_inclusion: Covers associated-item and function behavior outside the current failing batches and provides a non-pointer normative control case.

entries.short_construct_description: traits and strong types should differentiate logically distinct values
entries.reason_for_inclusion: Covers the associated-item / trait construct area the plan requires and checks that type- and trait-oriented grounding does not collapse into unrelated chapters.

entries.short_construct_description: integer values must not be converted into pointers via `as` or `transmute`
entries.reason_for_inclusion: Covers unsafe / pointer / provenance-adjacent constructs outside the active validation batches and is a direct test of pointer-routing generality.

entries.short_construct_description: prefer functions over macros unless macros are required for variadic or signature-shaping behavior
entries.reason_for_inclusion: Covers the function-signature / variadic / return-type area required by the plan using a held-out guideline that explicitly discusses variadic interfaces and function signatures.

entries.short_construct_description: union field reads must respect validity invariants before typed access
entries.reason_for_inclusion: Provides the glossary-heavy concept-chain case the plan requires because the rationale explicitly leans on glossary-linked validity-invariant concepts while still needing a non-glossary terminal paragraph.
